result.summary: Found several layout and content issues, primarily involving cut-off cards, truncated text, and inconsistent content clipping at the screen edge.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen, truncating the name and hiding delivery info.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal scroll container so cards are fully visible or clipped consistently with a visual cue (e.g., partial card peeking) rather than abrupt text truncation.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' appears truncated with no ellipsis styling or indication it's cut off intentionally.
issues.suggestion: Add proper text truncation with ellipsis or ensure enough card width to display full name.

issues.description: The pizza promotional image at the bottom of the screen is abruptly cut off by the navigation bar, with no visible title or details.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card content isn't obscured by the bottom navigation; add padding or scroll indication so users know more content is below.

issues.description: The horizontal category filter list (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) appears to have an additional category cut off at the right edge, suggesting incomplete scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade-out gradient or partial visibility cue at the edge to indicate more scrollable content.

issues.description: Notification bell icon has a red dot indicator with no accessible label or count, which may not be conveyed to screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Add an aria-label or accessible text describing the number of unread notifications.
